name: Sustained beam
description: A horizontal energy beam fired leftward from a small floating emitter on the right: a compact purple charge gathers as motes converge for one second, the beam extends to full length in 0.2 s, then holds for 2.3 s as a bright white core inside a magenta sheath whose edges flicker under UV-panned streak noise, flanked by two sharp magenta ribbons with a narrow vertical flare at the emitter. The core shuts off over 0.25 s and releases a fading yellow-green particle trail along the beam line, lit from a magenta pool under the emitter and a second light along the beam over a minimal grid.
